name: kimi-atlas
description: Turns a rough coding request into elite, verified, human-gated implemented code. A root orchestrator drives a deterministic state machine over the built-in coder/explore/plan subagents — carried on a first-class agentic backbone (a live ContextGraph, an explicit finite-state machine, and forward-only worktree rollback) — gated by a 6-lens verification harness and a deterministic quality backbone. No LLM ever computes pass/fail.
